propositions: Operators force-close ~25 administrative-disposition tickets (duplicate, obsolete, wontfix, stale-premise) because the existing completion-verification gate cannot PASS them and no discoverable alternative path exists

Non-bug ticket types (task, story, epic) have no valid administrative-class vocabulary; only bugs may use duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated, creating a systematic gap for administrative closes on non-bugs
The close-precheck refusal message never enumerates the available --class options for the ticket type, leaving operators unaware of a truthful exit
obsolete and wontfix dispositions require a mandatory reason, but the transition CLI rejects --reason outside of --force, blocking legitimate administrative closes
Reason-only administrative dispositions lack a signed attestation path; they need to mint a disposition verdict and sign it with class+reason manifest lines

The completion verifier must skip AC/file-impact/billable checks for reason-only administrative closes (obsolete/wontfix) and replacement-bearing classes (duplicate, superseded) must demand a live replacement link
